values.note: Minnesota state forest drive-in campsite, taxes included. Paid online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station; nothing is collected at the campground. DNR state forest fee page, read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Individual and equestrian campsites $17 - $22'; 'Fees include taxes'; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site or mail-in payments'), read 2026-11-11

note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground on a wooded point of Button Box Lake, with a boat access beside it. ATVs may not be ridden in the campground; they must be trailered in and out. Managed by Scenic State Park. --Claude
summary: DNR facility record and 2014 facility map read: 12 sites (10 drive-in, 2 walk-in; stored 13 derived), primitive, vault toilets + water, FCFS with same-day online payment at $17 incl. tax ('Pay on site' was wrong). No season stated. Lakeview kept (canopy). Website link needs the hyphen form.
flags: PHONE: 218-571-2600 confirmed (Scenic State Park, the manager on the DNR facility record). The 2014 facility map still says 'Contact McCarthy Beach State Park 218-254-7979'; the current record wins.

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept. The drive-in loop (sites 3-12) is on a wooded point; the pads nearest the water (the west side of the loop, sites 6-10 by the map, around 47.8540,-93.2897) are about 25-35 m from the shore but under continuous canopy on current imagery, so no open apron. The walk-in sites 1-2 are not counted for a rig.
